result.reason: The cyber/privacy addition reaches the preferred USD 5M limit, E&O remains at the permitted USD 1M fallback, workers’ compensation is statutory, and certificates are available on request. However, the general liability coverage still states only USD 1M without specifying USD 1M per occurrence and USD 2M aggregate, so the clause does not fully reach the playbook position. The edit is otherwise limited and preserves the existing commercial intent, though the E&O description remains awkwardly tied to bodily injury and property damage.
